project.name: islam-dubaev-portfolio
project.productType: Video editor and motion designer portfolio

design.colorMode: dark with a light biography section

typography.fonts: Self-hosted Manrope Latin/Cyrillic and Instrument Serif Latin; Georgia for Russian headlines

avoid: Apple Style represented as Apple client

decisions: Cinematic triptych with actual portfolio footage
Expressive serif headlines and oversized sans-serif name
Native dialog and custom video controls
Client-supplied open-stroke DUBAEV glyphs in an unbroken horizontal logo; green and white transparent exports
Experimental outline signature in the hero; original bold wordmark retained as requested
Custom keyboard-operated client and quality menus
Unmodified Adobe product icons from the official Adobe website
Native scrollbars use a rounded chartreuse thumb on a dark track; mobile hero cards have a 48-pixel top margin
Hero media group has a bounded width at each breakpoint so its three frames overlap on wide screens
Text reveals once on entering the viewport with a 620ms fade and 20px lift, short stagger delays, and reduced-motion opt-out
English-first EN/RU interface with a persistent language choice and localized printable CV
Client-supplied portrait in the biography, converted from HEIC to WebP
Subtle FloatingPathsBackground behind the hero with deterministic durations and reduced-motion/visibility/pause controls
